mechanism_claims.claim_text: TM8 treatment of C. auris CBS10913 is source-supported as causing cell-surface/membrane injury, based on SEM morphology and SYTO 9/propidium iodide flow-cytometry staining; this is accepted only as direct cell-envelope injury evidence, not a molecular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TM8 has direct fungicidal/time-kill activity against C. auris CBS10913, with a 3-log reduction at 1x MIC within 6 h and complete killing within 12 h, and faster fungicidal activity at 4x MIC.
